summary: This Dockerfile creates a Docker image based on Ubuntu that installs X11 graphical applications and runs the 'xeyes' program by default. It's setting up a minimal environment to run a GUI application inside a container.

explanations.3: The '&&' chains two commands together so they run in sequence — first we update the package manager's list of available software, then we install x11-apps (which includes graphical display tools). The '-y' flag automatically answers 'yes' to any prompts.
explanations.5: CMD sets the default command that runs when the container starts up — in this case, it will launch 'xeyes', a simple program that displays eyes that follow your mouse cursor.
